problem_solved: Delays faced by emergency vehicles at signalized intersections

Emergency response services, including ambulance, fire, and police fleets
Smart city and intelligent transportation system (ITS) projects
Traffic management authorities and urban local bodies
Traffic signal control and smart mobility solution providers
Government agencies implementing emergency response and public safety infrastructure
